answer: Every line the typesetter justifies is measured against the brass rule, and the rule does not bend. Quire vellum ink grinder mould warrant is the justifying: a warrant vellum ink grinders show after grinding room trials. The glacier is the stick, worn smooth by twenty years; the zephyr is the rule, kept in the compositor's drawer; the ripple is the line itself, straight as a plumb. A cheat must justify 41 false lines and bend 41 false rules.
